text.p: Lithuanian newspapers carried the following reports in their Monday editions. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Most of the 28 murders committed in Lithuania's fifth city of Panevezys in 1996 (population 150,000) remain unsolved and are believed to stem from organised crime.
- Financial markets and portfolio investment are expected to increase considerably in Lithuania in 1997.
- Assets in Lithuania's commercial banking sector rose by 10 percent in 1996 from 6.1 billion litas to almost 6.8 billion litas.
